tools.name: publish_files
tools.description: Publish an artifact from files on disk. Omit slug to create a new artifact (private to you); to republish, give slug and base_version (the live version) and the files; mode replace removes the artifact's files that are not named. Returns the slug, the new version and the claude.ai URL.

tools.name: get_artifact
tools.description: An artifact's current state without its content: slug, version id, title, read mode and claude.ai URL.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: The files an artifact holds, each with its served path.
